# dmidecode 3.6
Getting SMBIOS data from sysfs.
SMBIOS 3.7.0 present.

Handle 0x0015, DMI type 16, 23 bytes
Physical Memory Array
	Location: System Board Or Motherboard
	Use: System Memory
	Error Correction Type: Multi-bit ECC
	Maximum Capacity: 4 TB
	Error Information Handle: 0x0014
	Number Of Devices: 4

Handle 0x0019, DMI type 17, 100 bytes

	Array Handle: 0x0015
	Error Information Handle: 0x0018
	Total Width: 80 bits
	Data Width: 64 bits
	Size: 48 GB

	Speed: 4800 MT/s
	Manufacturer: Unknown

	Asset Tag: Not Specified
	Part Number: F5-6000R3036G48GQ

	Configured Memory Speed: 6000 MT/s
	Minimum Voltage: 1.1 V

	Memory Technology: DRAM
	Memory Operating Mode Capability: Volatile memory
	Firmware Version: Unknown
